notes.title: New Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Dear Shareholders, here are the details of this update:

What's New
1. New Cards: Introducing [Magician] and [Joker], a brand new duplication system that greatly enriches the gameplay. 2.
2. New props: Introducing [Midas Touch], welcome to the settlement frenzy!

Optimization and Adjustment
[HQ receives a large number of game feedbacks and targeting for comprehensive optimization, which is really a headache work].
1. Card Enhancement:
[Efficiency] Enhancement: +400 value ⇒ +1000 value
[Challenger] Enhancement: +3 Qty per challenge ⇒ +5 Qty
2. Metal Upgrade Chance and Value Adjustment: Spend 8 star coins per level to get an additional Metal Upgrade chance. Metal Upgrade value has been adjusted.
3. Yield optimization: Optimize the yield calculation formula, we are exploring a better one.
4. BGM update: 4 BGMs have been added.
5. New version compatibility: Players' level progress will no longer be reset after the new version update.
6. Text Optimization: Reduce ambiguous text to improve reading experience.
7. Metal tag probability balance: Metal tag probability is changed to weighted average, the game is more balanced.

Bug Fixes
[I hate bugs! --Rant from the programer]
1. Yield Rate: Fix the problem of Street Sell Stocks which causes wrong calculation of yield and loss of funds.
2. Misplaced Metal Settlement Position: Fix the problem of misplaced 'Again!' position during metal settlement.
3. Days Countdown Logic Optimization: Fix the problem that the countdown starts at the game preparation stage.
4. Street light blocking during metal settlement: Fix the problem of street light blocking during metal settlement.

We hope these updates can bring you a smoother and more enjoyable game experience. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to give us feedback. Thank you for your support!

Enjoy the game!
Yogo Studio

notes.title: Version Updates and Events!
notes.notes:
▼ Leaderboard Update
- Leaderboard function is on line. You can compete with players allover the world. There are three different leaderboard, which are total assets, yield, and metal settlement.

▼ Player Prize Contest
- In order to celebrate the launch of the leaderboards, we will reward the first player of each leaderboard with [The Best Indie Game of the Year "Balatro" CDkey*1].
- Activity Note: If someone cheats, the reward will be passed on to the next player in the ranking.
- Activity date until December 23, 2024 2am (UTC)

▼ Other Updates
- Game experience questionnaire updated
- Bug report updated
- UI optimization, metal combination icons added
- Adjustment of game values, optimization of game experience

▼ Apology
There are still occasional bugs in the card function development test, which will be released in the next version update.

notes.title: Game Update Preview
notes.notes:
1. Add online ranking function, divided into daily and weekly rankings, to see who is the first.
2. New effect cards, unique functions, and more brain-burning combination mode.
3. Add empowerment coupons to globally enhance card effects!

The update will be launched after the test is completed. And the game will continue to update.
